Footer.tagline: A free, open geography education platform.
Footer.note: Content is under active development; new provinces and topics are added regularly. Published data is based on official sources (TÜİK, HGM, Ministry of Interior, MGM).

Home.metaTitle: Coğrafya Platformu — Geography of Türkiye and the World
Home.metaDescription: Free, sourced geography content for the 81 provinces of Türkiye, the countries of the world and landforms. Maps, topic guides and more.
Home.heading: Explore Türkiye and the world through geography
Home.lede: Free geography pages — province, country and landform details, with curriculum-aligned topic guides.

Map.sectionHeading: Choose a province from the map
Map.sectionBody: Hover a province on the map of Türkiye (or focus it with the keyboard) and follow the card to its detail page. Published provinces are interactive; the rest are added as their content clears verification.
Map.mapTitle: Map of the provinces of Türkiye

About.metaDescription: Coğrafya Platformu is an education project that presents the geography of Türkiye and the world through free, sourced and accessible content.
About.heading: About
About.body1: Coğrafya Platformu is an education project that aims to make geography free and accessible to everyone. Content is grounded in authoritative sources and passes an independent verification step before publication.
About.body2: The platform is under development. This page is a demonstration of the multilingual architecture and SEO foundations; content will deepen as coverage expands.

Turkiye.metaDescription: Explore the 81 provinces of Türkiye on an interactive map. Location, population, area, climate and landforms — sourced, structured detail pages for each province.
Turkiye.heading: Map of Türkiye
Turkiye.intro: Explore the 81 provinces of Türkiye on an interactive map. Select a province to reach its sourced detail page covering location, population, climate and landforms.
Turkiye.gameCtaBody: {brand} is a find-the-place game played on this same map: a province or region is named, and you point it out. Free, no sign-up.

Game.metaDescription: A map game for finding Türkiye's 81 provinces and 7 geographical regions. Three modes: find the region, find all provinces, provinces by region. Free, no sign-up.
Game.heading: {brand} — Geography Map Game
Game.subtitle: Pick a mode and find the province or region on the map.
Game.teaches: The provinces and geographical regions of Türkiye
Game.mode1Body: Find Türkiye's seven geographical regions on the map.
Game.mode2Body: Find all 81 provinces on the map in a single round.
Game.mode3Body: Pick a region and find only the provinces inside it.
Game.regionPickerSubtitle: Choose a region and start its province round.
Game.regionRoundDescription: A round for finding the provinces of {region} on the map.
Game.noScript: The game needs JavaScript enabled in your browser.
Game.emptyPool: This round's questions could not be loaded, please try again shortly.
Game.confirmRestart: Starting over deletes the progress you have made in this round. Start over?
Game.summaryMissedNote: Each province opens its own page.
Game.summaryReviewNote: You found these, but it took a few tries. Their pages are worth a look.
Game.zoomInstructions: With the map focused, press + or = to zoom in and − to zoom out; use the arrow keys to pan and 0 or Home to return to the starting view. With a province focused, Enter or Space selects it. With a mouse you can zoom with the wheel and pan by dragging; on a touch screen, pinch to zoom and drag with one finger to pan.
Game.zoomHint: Zoom in to pick the smallest provinces

ProvinceDetail.heading: Geography of {name}

ProvinceDetail.introFallbackPopulation: {name} is a province in the {region} region of Türkiye, with a population of {population, number}.
ProvinceDetail.introFallbackArea: {name} is a province in the {region} region of Türkiye, covering an area of {area, number} km².

ProvinceDetail.hydrographyNone: This province has no significant rivers, lakes or dams.
ProvinceDetail.similarClimateIntro: Provinces with the same Köppen climate type ({koppen}) and the closest annual mean temperature:
ProvinceDetail.sources: Data is grounded in official sources: population from TÜİK (ADNKS), area from the General Directorate of Mapping (HGM), district count from the Ministry of Interior; climate and provincial-centre elevation/coordinates from MGM.
ProvinceDetail.backToMap: Back to the map of Türkiye

Climate.chartTitle: {name} — monthly mean temperature and precipitation chart
Climate.chartDesc: Monthly mean temperature ranges from {tempMin} to {tempMax} °C; the warmest month is {hottest} and the coldest is {coldest}. Monthly total precipitation ranges from {precipMin} to {precipMax} mm; the wettest month is {wettest} and the driest is {driest}. Columns show monthly total precipitation, the bold line shows monthly mean temperature, and the light band shows the monthly mean high–low temperature range.
Climate.tableCaption: {name} — monthly climate normals for the {start}–{end} measurement period (MGM General Statistics, k=A).
Climate.sourceLine: Monthly normals: <mgm>MGM General Statistics table (k=A)</mgm>, {start}–{end} measurement period. Annual mean, total and seasonal percentage figures are computed by us from this series; they are not values published by MGM.

Dunya.metaDescription: Explore the countries of the world on an interactive map. Location, capital, population, area and physical geography — sourced, structured detail pages for each country.
Dunya.heading: World Map
Dunya.intro: Explore the countries of the world on an interactive map. Select a country to reach its sourced detail page covering location, capital, population and physical geography. Coverage begins with Türkiye's neighbouring countries and expands as new countries are added.

WorldMap.sectionHeading: Choose a country from the map
WorldMap.sectionBody: Hover a country on the map (or focus it with the keyboard) and follow the card to its detail page. Published countries are interactive; the remaining countries and regions light up as their content is added.
WorldMap.keyboardInstructions: When the map is focused, press + or = to zoom in and − to zoom out; use the arrow keys to pan and 0 or Home to return to the world view. With a mouse, scroll to zoom and drag to pan; on touch, pinch to zoom and drag with one finger to pan.

CountryDetail.metaDescription: {name} lies in {continent}. Sourced key facts on its location, neighbouring countries and ISO code.
CountryDetail.metaDescriptionPopulation0: {name} is a country in {continent} with a population of {population, number}. Sourced key facts: location, neighbouring countries and ISO code.
CountryDetail.metaDescriptionPopulation1: With a population of {population, number}, {name} lies in {continent}. Its location, neighbouring-country count and ISO code, from sourced data, on one page.
CountryDetail.metaDescriptionPopulation2: Geography of {name}: a country in {continent} with {population, number} people. Sourced location, neighbouring-country and ISO-code figures.
CountryDetail.metaDescriptionArea: {name} is a country in {continent} covering {area, number} km². Sourced key facts: location, neighbouring countries and ISO code.
CountryDetail.metaDescriptionNeighbors: {name} is a country in {continent} with {neighborCount, number} neighbouring countries. Sourced key facts: location and ISO code.
CountryDetail.metaDescriptionCapital: {name}, a country in {continent}, has its capital at {capital}. Sourced key facts on the country's location and ISO code.
CountryDetail.heading: Geography of {name}
CountryDetail.introFallbackPopulation: {name} is a country in {continent}, with a population of {population, number}.
CountryDetail.introFallbackArea: {name} is a country in {continent}, covering an area of {area, number} km².
CountryDetail.sources: Data is grounded in official and authoritative sources: country and capital names from the Turkish Ministry of Foreign Affairs; population from the World Bank (Geostat 2024 census for Georgia); area from the World Bank; continent and region classification from the UN Statistics Division (M49); neighbouring countries, government form, currency and physical geography from cross-checked multi-source references (Britannica and others).
